scope: Author inspection of changed spans, not independent review of every baseline span or complete translation. Native runs determine which regressions are actually fixed.

confirmed_regressions.reason: Capitalized person name reinterpreted as a common noun, then matched to an abbreviation overlapping a French preposition.
Temporal all e way until is not a road. SMS article spelling escaped phrase protection.
Contacting park management was confused with a spatial direction.
The first-person verb prefer was confused with the unvocalized adjective better/best.
The source expresses preference for finding a train, not the adjective better.
The selected French est is the verb in est de 1, not east; the supplied full translation omitted the source location.
Done in have done was matched to the German infinitive marker in zu überleben, not a lexical completion meaning.
The nominalizer after sell was linked to job at the start of the target sentence; that occurrence corresponds to source 仕事.

review_concerns_not_certified_errors.reason: Chinese 一天 and day counterparts need quantity and carrier-boundary review; no blanket numeral rule is accepted.
Flexible-time/free-time expressions need contextual assessment rather than a blanket ban on cross-part-of-speech vocabulary.
Italian voti may mean grades or votes. The short capture lacks enough conversational context to certify the Portuguese votos counterpart.
